scenes.text: Meta just gave small businesses a *free AI agent*

scenes.title: What *Muse* is
lines: Meta's AI agent, opened to small businesses on Sept 29.
Free with usage limits. A paid plan if you need more.

scenes.title: What it *plugs into*
lines: Shopify, Stripe, QuickBooks, Canva, Klaviyo, Notion.
Plus your Instagram analytics and Facebook Page.

scenes.title: What it *does*
lines: Learns what you sell and how your brand sounds.
Drafts posts and replies, reads your numbers, finds customers.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: Free-tier limits apply. Check what it can post before you let it.

scenes.text: Run a small shop? Comment *MUSE* for the setup.
